svg.title: TOPAK I12 — Lease_A1.tla: the lease schema as amended by A1. A renewal keeps the confinement rung, so a principal never leaves Contained silently. Four invariants, each broken by its mutation: checked by TLC at rungs 0 to 3, proved and certified by TLAPS, and proved in Lean
svg.desc: The successor to Lease.tla (I11), drawn from its own text and every results file about it, all read at build time: what A1 changed, every definition compared with the frozen module's; the mechanism; the four properties; the mutation matrix, with A1's M_LOWER; the witnesses, with A1's rung-1 renewal; ADR-0031 §8's table compared row by row; every theorem and lemma, the certified run and the Lean re-encoding. What is checked or proved here is of the module, not of the reference. A1 was ratified on 2026.09.28 in Batch 10; the module's header, written before, calls it pending.

text.tspan: Proved in Lean, of the re-encoding

svg.text: Checked, proved and certified mean what ADR-0046 §1 says: TLC checks the mutations and witnesses at the module's constants; TLAPS proves each invariant under the hypothesis its statement names; the certified run accounts for every obligation by a route an independent checker accepted, or names LS4. Nothing here is said of the running reference.

text.tspan: What A1 changed: four definitions, two added, every other one the same as the frozen module's
Narrows(new, old) == new.alphabet \subseteq old.alphabet /\ new.rung <= old.rung
Refines(new, old) == Narrows(new, old) /\ new.role = old.role
Refines(new, old) == Narrows(new, old) /\ new.rung = old.rung /\ new.role = old.role
[] Mut = "M_LOWER" -> Narrows(new, old) /\ LowerOrSame(new, old) /\ new.role = old.role

svg.text: NeverRenewedAbove0 (line 187): NeverRenewedAbove0 == \A p \in Principals : ~(lease[p].live /\ prev[p].live /\ lease[p].rung >= 1)
Lease.tla is frozen at digest 7636c6c3364bca9c (G2 frozen-artifact rule); this module is its A1 successor and differs from it only where marked A1. A1: renewal keeps the
confinement rung. Lowering it under a live lease is a silent downgrade (ADR-0034 §3.4): the principal leaves Contained without the refusal that the grant path would have
made. Rungs run 0..3 (A1; the frozen module stopped at 2, so rung 3 was never exercised).
Every other definition is the same, comments aside, and every check both runs share has the same verdict (11 rows): ADR-0031 §8's "repeated every row with its result
unchanged". The A1 rows are mut-lower and reach-renew-above0.

text.tspan: The mechanism, as the module states it: one lease per principal per round, a renewal only narrows it, and the epoch fences every lease issued before it
: each principal's lease, and the one it replaced

svg.text: alphabet, rung, role, epoch and fence
live and at rung 1 or above; rung 0 is Mediated, always (§3). M_RUNG ignores the rung.
the fleet fence raises the epoch; a targeted revocation ends one lease and bars later grants (§5 R3)
① a grant only with no live lease: one per round (ADR-0031 §2), and not to a revoked principal (§5 R3). M_REVOKE
② a renewal at the same epoch must refine the lease: a narrower alphabet, the same rung and the same role (A1) (§4).
M_RENEW checks nothing; M_ROLE drops the role; M_LOWER lets the rung fall, the frozen rule.
③ an action only under a live lease at the current epoch (ADR-0022 §2). M_FENCE skips the epoch check.
asks for a grant, a renewal, or an action
a second lease in the round, a revoked principal's grant, a renewal that does not refine, an action at a fenced epoch
each admitted action, with the epoch it was admitted at and its lease's
⑥ EndRound(p), line 141: the lease ends with the round

Key. ① to ③ are the mechanism's checks; ④ the lease; ⑤ an admitted action; ⑥ the end of the round. Red marks where each mutation acts. The picture is the diagram's own drawing of the definitions below.

g.text: An action is admitted: NoActionUnderFencedEpoch ranges over real actions.
A renewal happens: LeaseAuthorityMonotone's antecedent is reached.
A renewal at rung 1 or above: the rung clause of Refines does not hold only because rung-0 leases were the only ones renewed (A1).
